job.prompt: Create a top-down survival game where I must dodge enemy projectiles and survive as long as possible. I have three health points. Enemies continuously spawn at random valid positions. Each spawned enemy randomly becomes either a chaser or a shooter. Chasers pursue the player. Shooters fire five bullets, with one second between consecutive shots, then disappear. The game ends when my health reaches zero, and my score is based on how long I survive. Do not include quests, inventory, NPC conversations, collectibles, or exit gates.

events.detail: Interpreting central loop, controls and constraints
Planning top-down adventure with configured provider
Constructing validated world, requested actors and typed gameplay relationships
Selecting one coherent registered visual family and semantic actor/quest resources
Checking destination connectivity, dialogue references and quest prerequisites
Adventure Phaser adapter and licensed tilemaps ready
Running real Chromium adventure interaction checks
